source.name: Memphis Grizzlies announce partnership with Robinhood (NBA.com/Grizzlies)
source.quote: announced a multi-year partnership with financial services company Robinhood Markets, Inc. as the official investing and jersey patch partner of the Grizzlies
source.note: The release continues: 'The Robinhood logo will be featured on the upper left chest of all Grizzlies uniforms beginning with the 2024-25 season.' The page renders its body with JavaScript; the quoted words sit in the page's embedded article data and description meta tag.
